name: two-engines-gate
description: Review and merge gate for Claude Code and Codex. Tests and a read-only review by the other engine are recorded for each commit, and the merge check refuses unless HEAD has both.

interface.shortDescription: Tests and a review by the other engine for each commit before it merges
interface.longDescription: Three bash scripts check one commit before it merges. gate.sh runs the project's tests on a clean checkout and records a pass for that commit. review.sh sends the commits and the diff to the engine that did not write them, read-only, and saves the verdict under the commit. merge-check.sh refuses unless the checkout is clean and HEAD has a pass and an ACCEPT from the other engine. Nothing is pushed or merged by the scripts.
